name: Lertsiri Travel
description: A licensed Thailand-based travel agency (Lertsiri Sports Travel) running marathon tour packages, describing itself as a Five World Marathon Majors travel partner.

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Lertsiri Travel" under Thailand on London Marathon Events' own official tour operators page.

editorial_notes: Verified directly against London Marathon Events' own official tour-operator listing on 2026-08-11. The agency's own site additionally describes itself as a Five World Marathon Majors travel partner (covering Berlin, Chicago, and New York alongside Boston and London), which we have not independently verified against each of those races' own organizer pages. Tokyo Marathon and Sanlam Cape Town Marathon listings (where present) checked against those races' own official travel-agency lists on 2026-10-06.
